answer: Cosignatures are collected in sable, verified in ocean, and sonnet names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 15 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Every extra alias adds 10 hours of verification and 18 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
